### A Distinguished Life
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-october-7-2024.html
Passage: Daniel 6:3-4
Points:
- Daniel distinguished himself in pagan public service through an extraordinary spirit and steadfast integrity.
- He maintained complete consistency between his public responsibilities and his private commitment to God.
- Jealous colleagues investigated his conduct but could uncover no negligence, dishonesty, or grounds for complaint.
- Because of his blameless character, his rivals realized they could only trap him regarding his devotion to God.
- Holy living and unwavering conviction often invite hostility and opposition from worldly peers.
- Believers must cultivate a deep passion for integrity and remain committed to God regardless of what others think.
